name: Kitchen knife skills
description: Prepare ingredients safely and consistently by choosing suitable cuts, controlling the knife, and keeping the work surface stable.

levels.name: Safe basics
levels.completion_criterion: Set up a stable cutting board and demonstrate a safe grip and guiding-hand position while cutting one soft ingredient into pieces.
levels.can_do: Use a kitchen knife with controlled, deliberate movements and keep fingertips out of the blade path.
levels.safety_requirements: Use a stable board; cut away from the body where appropriate; keep fingers clear and the knife sharp and controlled.

levels.name: Consistent cuts
levels.completion_criterion: Prepare two different ingredients with reasonably even slices and cubes, with pieces cooking or serving consistently.
levels.can_do: Choose a suitable basic cut and maintain control and consistency across different ingredients.
levels.safety_requirements: Maintain a stable board and safe guiding-hand position; do not rush for speed.

levels.name: Confident prep
levels.completion_criterion: Prepare a small meal’s ingredients using at least three suitable cut types while keeping the work area organised and safe.
levels.can_do: Select and execute useful cuts with consistent size and safe workflow.
levels.safety_requirements: Keep the work area uncluttered, carry knives safely, and store them securely after use.

emoji_rationale: The knife is the defining tool of this practical technique.
safety_notes: Prioritise control and safety over speed.

name: Cook rice reliably
description: Control water, heat, timing, and resting so rice cooks evenly and reaches the intended texture. The progression focuses on method and consistency rather than collecting rice recipes.

levels.name: Follow a method
levels.completion_criterion: Cook one batch of rice using a reliable method and produce grains that are cooked through without a pool of excess water.
levels.can_do: Measure ingredients and follow a basic rice-cooking sequence.
levels.safety_requirements: Handle hot pans and steam carefully.

levels.name: Control texture
levels.completion_criterion: Repeat the method successfully twice and identify how rinsing, liquid ratio, heat, or resting affected the texture.
levels.can_do: Adjust the process to avoid a wet, hard, or scorched result.
levels.safety_requirements: Use suitable cookware and keep the lid and hot steam clear of the face.

levels.name: Adapt independently
levels.completion_criterion: Prepare rice for two different meal contexts and explain the process change needed for the target texture or serving time.
levels.can_do: Choose and adapt a method based on quantity, desired texture, and timing.
levels.safety_requirements: Refrigerate cooked rice promptly when not serving immediately and follow local food-safety guidance.

emoji_rationale: A direct, recognisable symbol for the specific foundational cooking technique.
safety_notes: Pay attention to hot steam and safe storage of cooked rice.

name: Basic baking techniques
description: Learn how ingredient handling and mixing methods affect baked results, including kneading dough, rubbing fat into flour, and making batter. This is a technique skill, not a separate skill for every baked dish.

levels.name: Prepare and mix
levels.completion_criterion: Measure ingredients and make one simple batter or rubbed-in mixture with the texture described by a trustworthy recipe.
levels.can_do: Recognise the initial texture cues for a basic baking mixture and avoid obvious overmixing.
levels.safety_requirements: Use oven mitts for hot trays and follow safe handling instructions for equipment.

levels.name: Work the mixture
levels.completion_criterion: Make a simple dough and demonstrate controlled kneading until it reaches the recipe’s stated texture, or explain why the chosen mixture should not be kneaded.
levels.can_do: Choose between mixing, rubbing-in, and kneading based on the type of mixture.
levels.safety_requirements: Clean work surfaces and avoid cross-contact with allergens where relevant.

levels.name: Choose and troubleshoot
levels.completion_criterion: Complete a simple baked item and identify one evidence-based adjustment after evaluating its texture or structure.
levels.can_do: Select a suitable mixing technique and make a reasoned adjustment to improve consistency.
levels.safety_requirements: Check doneness appropriately and handle hot cookware safely.

emoji_rationale: A mixing bowl represents the shared preparation techniques without reducing the skill to one baked dish.
safety_notes: Account for hot equipment and ingredient allergens.

name: Pan-searing and browning
description: Use surface dryness, pan heat, spacing, and timing to create even browning while cooking food to an appropriate doneness. Steak is an example for practice, not a separate skill.

levels.name: Create a sear
levels.completion_criterion: Brown a suitable food item in a pan without crowding it and identify the visual signs of a properly browned surface.
levels.can_do: Prepare the surface and manage pan contact to encourage browning rather than steaming.
levels.safety_requirements: Keep hands away from splattering fat and use appropriate heat-resistant tools.

levels.name: Control the heat
levels.completion_criterion: Repeat the technique with more even browning and explain how pan heat, moisture, and crowding affected the outcome.
levels.can_do: Adjust heat and batch size to produce a consistent result.
levels.safety_requirements: Avoid overheating oil and manage splattering safely.

levels.name: Manage doneness
levels.completion_criterion: Cook a suitable item to a stated doneness using a reliable timing or thermometer method and allow an appropriate rest where relevant.
levels.can_do: Coordinate browning with safe, appropriate internal doneness instead of judging colour alone.
levels.safety_requirements: Follow trusted food-safety temperature guidance for the specific food.

emoji_rationale: The pan directly represents the heat-control technique.
safety_notes: Hot oil can splatter; use food-specific safety guidance and a thermometer when appropriate.

name: Make sauces and dressings
description: Build flavour and control consistency in simple cold dressings and hot sauces, using tasting and adjustment rather than following a single recipe mechanically.

levels.name: Mix a dressing
levels.completion_criterion: Prepare a simple dressing with balanced acidity, fat, and seasoning, then adjust it after tasting.
levels.can_do: Combine ingredients in a stable, reasonably balanced dressing.
levels.safety_requirements: Use clean utensils and store perishable ingredients safely.

levels.name: Make a smooth sauce
levels.completion_criterion: Prepare a simple gravy or pan sauce with no obvious lumps and a consistency appropriate to the dish.
levels.can_do: Control liquid addition, mixing, heat, and seasoning.
levels.safety_requirements: Take care around hot liquids and steam.

levels.name: Adjust by outcome
levels.completion_criterion: Prepare either a cold dressing or hot sauce from a basic formula and make two deliberate adjustments to achieve the intended flavour and consistency.
levels.can_do: Diagnose whether a sauce needs adjustment to acidity, salt, thickness, or dilution.
levels.safety_requirements: Taste only when food is at a safe temperature and use clean tasting utensils.

emoji_rationale: A jar suggests mixing and adjusting dressings and sauces without tying the skill to one dish.
safety_notes: Handle hot sauces carefully and apply safe storage guidance to perishable mixtures.

name: Make stock and broth
description: Extract flavour from suitable ingredients with controlled simmering, then strain, cool, and store the liquid safely for later cooking.

levels.name: Make a basic stock
levels.completion_criterion: Prepare a simple stock or broth using a clear method and strain it without leaving unwanted solids.
levels.can_do: Follow a basic ingredient, water, and simmering sequence.
levels.safety_requirements: Handle hot liquids carefully and strain with stable, heat-safe equipment.

levels.name: Control extraction
levels.completion_criterion: Produce a repeatable result by maintaining a gentle simmer and explaining how time and ingredients affect flavour and clarity.
levels.can_do: Avoid unnecessarily vigorous boiling and adjust the process to the intended use.
levels.safety_requirements: Keep hot pots stable and away from edges.

levels.name: Use and store well
levels.completion_criterion: Prepare stock for a planned dish, evaluate its flavour, and cool and store leftovers according to reliable food-safety guidance.
levels.can_do: Produce a useful cooking base and manage it safely beyond the initial preparation.
levels.safety_requirements: Cool and refrigerate or freeze promptly according to current food-safety guidance.

emoji_rationale: A simmering pot is the defining object of stock and broth preparation.
safety_notes: Hot liquid and safe cooling/storage are key concerns.

name: Egg preparation techniques
description: Handle eggs cleanly and perform common preparation techniques, including separating an egg and poaching it. The skill is evaluated by process control, not by collecting egg recipes.

levels.name: Handle and separate
levels.completion_criterion: Separate an egg into yolk and white with minimal mixing and without shell fragments in the portions.
levels.can_do: Use a controlled method for separating an egg and keep the work area clean.
levels.safety_requirements: Wash hands after handling raw eggs and avoid cross-contamination.

levels.name: Poach successfully
levels.completion_criterion: Poach an egg so the white is set and the result matches the selected method’s target texture.
levels.can_do: Manage water conditions and transfer the egg without breaking it unnecessarily.
levels.safety_requirements: Use care around hot water and follow food-safety advice for the intended consumer.

levels.name: Choose the method
levels.completion_criterion: Choose and perform two egg techniques for different cooking goals, explaining the cues used to judge the result.
levels.can_do: Select a suitable technique and adjust handling to achieve a deliberate texture.
levels.safety_requirements: Observe safe handling, cooking, and storage practices for eggs.

emoji_rationale: The egg is the common ingredient across the techniques.
safety_notes: Apply current guidance on raw eggs, cross-contamination, cooking, and storage.

name: Kitchen food safety
description: Organise food preparation to reduce avoidable risks from contamination, unsafe handling, knives, heat, and storage.

levels.name: Safe setup
levels.completion_criterion: Prepare a clean workspace, identify likely hazards in a simple cooking task, and choose safe handling steps before beginning.
levels.can_do: Recognise common kitchen hazards and prepare a safer workflow.
levels.safety_requirements: Use a stable work area, keep sharp tools controlled, and avoid unsafe contact between raw and ready-to-eat food.

levels.name: Prevent cross-contamination
levels.completion_criterion: Complete a simple preparation task using separate clean tools/surfaces as appropriate and demonstrate correct handwashing at relevant points.
levels.can_do: Manage tools, hands, and food surfaces to reduce cross-contamination.
levels.safety_requirements: Follow local food-safety guidance for high-risk foods and allergens.

levels.name: Plan a safe workflow
levels.completion_criterion: Plan and complete a multi-step meal while managing raw foods, hot equipment, cleaning, and safe storage appropriately.
levels.can_do: Anticipate risks across the workflow rather than reacting only after a problem appears.
levels.safety_requirements: Use current authoritative guidance for cooking temperatures, cooling, storage, and allergens.

emoji_rationale: Clean hands and surfaces are central visual shorthand for kitchen hygiene.
safety_notes: Follow up-to-date local food-safety and allergen guidance.

name: Personal budgeting and saving
description: Set practical money goals, map income and expenses, make a usable budget, and review it to support deliberate saving decisions. This is personal financial capability, not business budget management.

levels.name: Map the month
levels.completion_criterion: Record income and expenses for a chosen period and group them into a small number of understandable categories.
levels.can_do: See where money comes from and where it goes without relying on memory alone.

levels.name: Create a workable budget
levels.completion_criterion: Build a monthly plan that accounts for known expenses, sets a realistic goal, and leaves any shortfall or surplus visible.
levels.can_do: Allocate money intentionally and identify trade-offs before spending.
levels.safety_requirements: Keep personal financial records secure and do not share account credentials.

levels.name: Review and adapt
levels.completion_criterion: Review actual spending against a budget for at least two periods, explain the main deviations, and adjust the plan or savings target.
levels.can_do: Use observed patterns to maintain a realistic budget and make deliberate adjustments.
levels.safety_requirements: Keep records private and use qualified advice for complex financial circumstances.

emoji_rationale: A receipt represents tracking and reviewing everyday money flows.
safety_notes: Do not include passwords, full account numbers, or other credentials in notes.

name: Compare financial offers
description: Find reliable information and compare financial products or offers using the terms that matter, rather than choosing from headline prices alone.

levels.name: Find reliable information
levels.completion_criterion: Find two comparable offers and record where the information came from, including the key terms and fees available.
levels.can_do: Locate relevant information and distinguish source material from unsupported claims.
levels.safety_requirements: Avoid sharing personal or account information with unverified websites.

levels.name: Compare like for like
levels.completion_criterion: Compare two offers using the same assumptions and a written table of price, fees, conditions, and relevant restrictions.
levels.can_do: Identify which terms materially change the value of an offer.
levels.safety_requirements: Check official terms and beware of misleading promotional claims.

levels.name: Explain a decision
levels.completion_criterion: Compare at least three options or scenarios and explain the trade-offs and uncertainties behind a choice.
levels.can_do: Make a transparent, evidence-based consumer comparison rather than relying on a headline figure.
levels.safety_requirements: Treat this as general decision-making practice, not personalised investment or legal advice.

emoji_rationale: Scales represent weighing comparable terms and trade-offs.
safety_notes: Use trustworthy sources and protect personal information.

name: Understand interest costs
description: Understand how interest affects borrowing costs and compare the cost of credit using the actual terms and repayment assumptions.

levels.name: Read the basic terms
levels.completion_criterion: Identify the interest rate, relevant fees, repayment period, and total amount repayable in a clearly described example.
levels.can_do: Recognise which terms affect the cost of borrowing.

levels.name: Compare scenarios
levels.completion_criterion: Calculate or verify the total cost for two simple borrowing scenarios using the provided rates, fees, and repayment assumptions.
levels.can_do: Explain why a lower advertised rate does not always mean the lowest total cost.
levels.safety_requirements: Use a reliable calculator or official disclosure and state assumptions.

levels.name: Explain the trade-offs
levels.completion_criterion: Compare two credit examples with different rates, fees, or terms and explain how each change affects the total paid and repayment burden.
levels.can_do: Interpret cost information and communicate the trade-offs without confusing rate and total cost.
levels.safety_requirements: Use the exact terms of the offer; this exercise is not personalised borrowing advice.

emoji_rationale: A bank represents the context where borrowing terms and interest costs are evaluated.
safety_notes: The displayed result depends on assumptions, fees, rate type, and repayment schedule.
